    ]

    # Read all source tables and concatenate them
    dfs = []

        df['addr_state'] = df['addr_state'].astype(int)
        dfs.append(df)

    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target schema is just ['addr_state'] integer, so no further transformation needed
    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_53/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
